sources.title: HuggingFaceTB/smoltalk2 · Datasets at Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This dataset contains three subsets (Mid, SFT, Preference) that correspond to the three phases of Post-Training for SmolLM3-3B. You can find more details in our blog post about how we used the data in each of the stages SmolLM3. The specific weight of each subset is available in the training recipe in SmolLM's repository.
